## Stop truncating the permanent change-intent record in triediffs. — 2026-08-03 (parent e4af5e2fb864)

**Replace truncating _one_line with new _first_line helper in render_digest_section so the permanent digest records full change intent without ellipsis or sentence-boundary cuts.**

The digest's per-symbol change bullets and staged bullets previously used `_one_line`, which cuts text at a sentence boundary or 160 characters and appends an ellipsis — silently discarding intent from the only permanent, archived record of why a symbol changed.

The fix introduces `_first_line`, a new helper in `trie/session_diff` that returns the complete first non-empty line of text with whitespace runs collapsed to single spaces, applying no character cap and no ellipsis. `render_digest_section` now uses `_first_line` for those bullets; the digest title continues to use `_one_line` for its short headline.

Two regression tests guard this contract:
- `test_first_line_preserves_full_intent_without_truncation` — verifies `_first_line` behaviour directly: no sentence cut, no cap, no ellipsis, whitespace collapsed, empty for blank input.
- `test_change_bullets_record_full_intent_no_ellipsis` — verifies that `render_digest_section` records long notes verbatim in both change and staged bullets with no ellipsis in the Changes section.
